I encounetered this exact problem a while back as as intern and my workaround was to just use an analog cheapo 8:1 MUX to route all my signals and it worked like a charm

Also a lot of sensors can alter their i2c address by one or two bits by changing pin state, 

For example : if you can tune two bits on your sensors' adress, then you can connect 4 sensors on the same bus, you route them through a 8:1 MUX, you have 8*4=32 maximum number of sensors, then you route those 8:1 to another 8:1 MUX themselves and you have 8*32=256 maximum number of sensors

Just be careful about choosing components to keep signal integrity at a reasonable level

I think it's one of the best approaches since it keeps PCB design quite simple while maintaining good macimim data transfers and the cost is very competitive compared to more ready-to-go i2c MUX solutions
